bullets.original: [Elegant Design & Versatile Use] The front features a stylish quilted pattern, perfect for loveseat, L-shaped sofas, and recliner. L shape couch cover also serves multiple purposes, such as a baby play mat, bedroom rug, or window seat cushion, making it ideal for both children and pets.

bullets.original: [Non-Slip & All-Season Protection] The back is equipped with anti-slip silicone particles to ensure better stability. Anti slip sofa slipcovers is warm yet breathable, suitable for year-round use, and protects your sofa from dirt and scratches throughout the year.
bullets.rewritten: [Anti-Slip Silicone Back — Year-Round Sofa Protection] Backed with anti-slip silicone particles for stability; warm yet breathable — protects your sofa from dirt, scratches and daily wear year-round.
bullets.factCheck: 'Anti-slip silicone particles' is a specific feature claim — plausible at this price point for cover products. 'Warm yet breathable' is a qualitative material claim. 'Year-round use' is an overstatement — no thermal rating given. Acceptable marketing language.

bullets.original: [Easy to Install & Clean] The plush material does not shed and retains its color even after machine washing (do not bleach). This ease of maintenance frees your hands from household chores.

bullets.factCheck: 'Plush material does not shed' is a testable claim — plausible for velvet. 'Retains color even after machine washing' is a durability claim, can't verify but plausible for quality velvet. 'Do not bleach' is care instruction, accurate.
